create_truncate_dataset: create a TruncateDataset to truncate sequences to a fixed number of tokens
create_random_crop_dataset: create a RandomCropDataset to randomly crop sequences to a fixed length
use_maybe_shorten_dataset: use maybe_shorten_dataset to conditionally shorten a dataset by truncate or random_crop method
review_TruncateDataset_getitem: review the TruncateDataset __getitem__ method that returns the first N tokens of a sequence
review_RandomCropDataset_set_epoch: review the RandomCropDataset set_epoch method to configure epoch-aware random cropping
